nodes.name: mockServiceWorker.js
nodes.summary: MSW-generated service worker that intercepts fetch requests from controlled clients and forwards them to in-page handlers for mocked responses.
nodes.languageNotes: Auto-generated by msw; uses MessageChannel round-trips between the worker and the page to resolve mocked responses.

nodes.name: handleRequest
nodes.summary: Resolves the main client, asks it for a mocked response, and forwards response/error lifecycle events back.

nodes.name: resolveMainClient
nodes.summary: Finds the active window client that controls the request, preferring the one matching the event's clientId.

nodes.name: getResponse
nodes.summary: Sends the serialized request to the client and returns a passthrough or mocked Response based on its reply.

nodes.name: sendToClient
nodes.summary: Posts a message to a client over a MessageChannel and resolves with the reply.

nodes.name: respondWithMock
nodes.summary: Builds a Response from the mocked payload, handling status 0 and Response.error().

nodes.name: serializeRequest
nodes.summary: Converts a Request into a plain object with buffered body for postMessage.
